hero.line2: For a region worth living in.
hero.intro: We are a volunteer civic tech community from Flensburg. We build open source projects, use open data and make information from local government, the city and the region accessible.
hero.map: Light street map of Flensburg and its fjord. Blue dots are decorative.
hero.caption: Data. People. Common good.

home.joinText: Want to work on real projects for your city? Whether you code, design, work with data or are simply curious – we look forward to meeting you!
home.associationText: The supporting association provides an organisational home for our shared commitment.
home.networkText: We are part of Code for Germany, the network for open data and technology for the common good.
